title: Reverse-trade correction (grid/martingale) exit bug fix: pip-total-sum profit check replaced with money-based close
entry_long: correction (reverse-trade/แก้ไม้) order opens when adverse move exceeds a configured pip-gap threshold AND price shows a reversal pattern relative to Bollinger Band (e.g. two candles' high above upper band signals a top for a sell correction order)
entry_short: mirror logic: reversal signal relative to lower Bollinger Band triggers a buy correction order
exit: originally checked unrealized profit via 'pip Total sum' block in Check Profit Unrealized - found NOT to trigger timely closes even when correction orders were profitable; fixed by switching to money-based profit check (Close Money) which closes as soon as monetary profit is realized
escalation_cap: unspecified (lot doubled per correction leg: 0.1 -> 0.2 -> ... -> 0.8 lot by the 4th order; no explicit step-count cap or lot cap stated in this clip)
buildon_idea: add an explicit hard cap on correction-order count/lot size to the martingale recovery ladder; swap the doubling lot law to linear-add or log-scaled growth to reduce fat-tail blowup risk; keep the money-based close fix (proven better than pip-sum) but add a per-leg SL and a max-total-loss kill switch
novelty_note: common recovery/hedge-grid correction mechanism (แก้ไม้/reverse trade) using Bollinger Band for re-entry timing; the useful transferable insight is a debugging finding - a pip-total-sum profit check silently fails to close in time, while a money-based profit check works correctly - relevant for any of our own grid/recovery EAs using similar exit logic
